title: nyxloom agent-authored judgement (CR-03, DR-13)
description: The half of an agent result an AGENT may author: what it concluded, and which task/attempt it believes it was working on. It deliberately cannot express evidence, commits, or digests -- those are mechanically knowable and the wrapper stamps them, so an agent cannot claim a fact about the repository that the repository disagrees with. The wrapper reads this, binds it to the facts, and produces an agent-result document; the controller reads only that.

attempt_id.description: The attempt id the agent was given in its packet. Echoing it is what binds the judgement to one run: a file left on the branch by a previous attempt names that attempt and is therefore inert, without any rule about which file is newest.
